panels.title: All Linux hosts
panels.description: Inside an LXC the kernel CPU figure is the hypervisor's, so LXC CPU is shown in the Proxmox guest table below instead.

panels.title: Guests
panels.description: From the hypervisor, so CPU is accurate per guest. Stopped guests are intentionally off (not alerted).

panels.title: NAS RAID
panels.description: Synology RAID state. Alerts if degraded or crashed.

panels.title: LVM thin pools: data / metadata
panels.description: Thin-pool DATA fill (alerts at 85%). A full pool, or full METADATA (alerts at 75%), freezes every guest on it.

panels.title: Disk health (SMART): early warning, not failure

panels.title: Proxmox host drives (pve0)
panels.description: SATA drive via SMART attributes; NVMe via its health log. Wear = life consumed. Errors = reallocated sectors (SATA) or media errors (NVMe); Unreadable = pending + uncorrectable sectors. Alerts on growth/any non-zero.

targets.expr: max by (disk, device_model, type) (label_replace(smartmon_device_info{host="pve0"}, "device_model", "NVMe SSD (1 TB)", "type", "nvme"))

panels.title: Backup freshness (per guest, per target)
panels.description: Allowed age: 30 h for the nightly job, 17 days for the twice-monthly offsite copy. Red = overdue.

targets.expr: max by (name, storage) ((time() - rl_pve_backup_last_success_timestamp_seconds) / on(storage) group_left max by (storage) (rl_pve_backup_max_age_seconds))

panels.title: Unprotected guests
panels.description: Guests Proxmox says are in no backup job (stopped ones may be intentional).

panels.title: NAS Hyper Backup
panels.description: Time since the last completed Hyper Backup (NAS -> pi-pcb). Runs daily ~09:35; red after 28 h.

panels.title: HB version
panels.description: Newest committed Hyper Backup version number.
